justification: Both surfaces carry human-derived imagery rendered schematically, and both include disc-like elements and simple linear marks, but this is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A shows a single monumental frontal figure whose body is covered with a small number of large ordered motifs (a central disc, arcs, bands), while B shows dozens of small silhouetted stick-like people scattered in an animated crowd across an open field, with no compositional or relational correspondence whatever.
